title: Which cycle time matters when two track-link quench-and-temper lines share a robot?
summary: A revised Suneng track-link quenching-and-tempering proposal connects two heat-treatment lines to one forging line, with a shared loading robot dividing the flow. A slower average arrival rate on each furnace line does not mean the shared robot may run at half speed. Selection must consider total incoming rhythm, both lines' receiving states and the actual load including grippers.
